
### HTTP authentication (RFC 7235)  {.smaller}



* relatively uncommon today compared to cookies (next topic) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* server$\rightarrow$ client: 401 Unauthorized with <i>WWW-Authenticate</i> header 

   * typically: web browser shows login prompt
<hr class="vspace" />
* client$\rightarrow$ server: Authorization header 

   * example: <code>Authorization: Basic dGVzdDoxMjPCow==</code>
   * <code>test:123</code> in Base64 (username test, password 123)
   * example: <code>Authorization: Bearer mF_9.B5f-4.1JqM</code>
   * bearer ‘token’ obtained [out of band]{.fragment fragment-index=2 .custom .myem-only} (common in application ‘APIs’)

::: {.fragment .myoverbox .highright .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2}
